title: Fire vs Water planning a trip
caption:
Every trip has one of each.

Fire books the flights the hour prices drop and builds a spreadsheet with tabs. Water says 'let's see closer to the time' and somehow still gets a better deal. Traditionally, Fire and Water balance each other: one brings the plan, one brings the peace.

Tag the person you travel with. Which one are they?
